programs.title: The Boy
programs.desc: Greta takes a job as a nanny, only to discover that the family’s 8-year-old is a life-sized doll that the parents care for like a real boy.

programs.title: Winchester
programs.desc: Inspired by true events. This is the most haunted house in the world, built by the heiress Sarah Winchester as an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts with scores to settle.

programs.title: Righteous Kill

programs.title: Leatherface
programs.desc: A young nurse is kidnapped by four violent teens who escape from a mental hospital and take her on a road trip of hell.
